phrases.RCLB_DESC: the lower bound C_ref - I/3 positive semidefinite for the formal matrix Cref at u = R 0 in an orthonormal frame, for d = 2 or 3 as the Prop states it, its IsHermitian half included (ReferenceCovarianceLowerBound: the odd-order contractions of the even kernel Kinf vanish at 0, and Cref - I/3 decomposes entrywise into a diagonal matrix and two rank-one squares; the proof does not use the hypothesis d = 2 or d = 3, and only the helper Aux.cv_psd, not an inventory theorem, is stated for every 0 < d; Cref is not shown to be the covariance of any random vector, symmetry of Cref d u R for a general u or frame is not stated, and main's odd_block_eigenvalues, odd_block_shifted_minors and smaller_eigenvalue_exceeds_third are neither imported, cited nor relied on: no minor, no eigenvalue 8 +/- sqrt 58 and no comparison of an eigenvalue with 1/3 is computed);
